func:
// === Assemble le payload pour sensor.cumulus_automation ===

const attrs = {
    reason: msg.reason,
    action: msg.action,
    desired: msg.desired,
    current_switch: msg.switchState,
    switch_available: msg.switchAvailable === true,
    enabled: msg.enabled,

    target_temp: msg.target,
    min_temp: msg.minT,
    reach_for: msg.reachFor,
    forcage_threshold: msg.forcageThreshold,
    stop_temp: msg.stopTemp,
    tank_volume_l: msg.tankL,

    // --- Modulation météo ---
    tomorrow_mode: msg.tomorrowMode,
    tomorrow_score: msg.tomorrowScore,
    worst_next2_score: msg.worstNext2Score,
    worst_next2_kwh: msg.worstNext2Kwh,
    trig_mult: msg.trigMult,

    // --- Prévisions brutes ---
    today_forecast_kwh: msg.kwhToday,
    today_remaining_kwh: msg.kwhTodayRemaining,
    tomorrow_forecast_kwh: msg.kwhTomorrow,
    tomorrow_p10_kwh: msg.kwhTomorrowP10,
    tomorrow_p90_kwh: msg.kwhTomorrowP90,
    day_after_forecast_kwh: msg.kwhDayAfter,
    day_after_p10_kwh: msg.kwhDayAfterP10,
    day_after_p90_kwh: msg.kwhDayAfterP90,

    solar_trigger: msg.solarTrig,
    effective_trigger: msg.effectiveTrigger,
    efficiency: msg.eff,
    forecast_field: msg.forecastField,
    solcast_stale: msg.solcastStale === true,
    solcast_age_hours: msg.solcastAgeHours != null ? msg.solcastAgeHours : -1,

    water_temp: msg.temp,
    temp_sensor_available: msg.tempAvailable === true,

    // --- Cumulus solaire amont (préchauffe en série) ---
    solar_upstream_temp: msg.solarTankTemp,
    solar_upstream_available: msg.solarTempAvailable === true,
    solar_covers_target: msg.solarCoversTarget === true,
    solar_sufficient_threshold: msg.solarSufficientThreshold,
    solar_sufficient_margin: msg.solarSufficientMargin,

    degraded_sonde: msg.degradedSonde === true,
    sonde_down_hours: msg.sondeDownHours || 0,
    solar_power: msg.solar,
    grid_power: msg.gridPower,
    house_consumption: msg.houseConsumption,
    cumulus_power: msg.cumulusPower,
    thermostat_tripped: msg.thermostatTripped === true,

    surplus: msg.surplus,
    potential_surplus: msg.potentialSurplus,
    surplus_trigger: msg.surplusTrig,
    anti_injection_active: msg.antiInjActive === true,
    anti_injection_useful: msg.antiInjUseful === true,

    legionella_due: msg.legionellaDue === true,
    legionella_critical: msg.legionellaCritical === true,
    legionella_critical_pending: msg.legionellaCriticalPending === true,
    legionella_blocked: msg.legionellaBlocked === true,
    days_since_high_temp: msg.daysSinceHighTemp,

    manual_hold_active: msg.manualHoldActive === true,

    delta_t: Math.round((msg.dt || 0) * 10) / 10,
    dt_forcing: msg.dtForcing || 0,
    energy_needed_kwh: msg.energyKwh || 0,
    duration_minutes: msg.durationMin || 0,
    window_avg_w: msg.windowAvgW || 0,
    window_min_avg_w: msg.minAvgW || 0,
    in_window: msg.inWindow === true,
    is_forcing: msg.isForcing === true,

    last_update: new Date(msg.now).toISOString(),
    friendly_name: 'Cumulus Automation'
};

if (msg.windowSkippedReason) attrs.window_skipped_reason = msg.windowSkippedReason;
if (msg.windowStart)         attrs.window_start = new Date(msg.windowStart).toISOString();
if (msg.windowEnd)           attrs.window_end = new Date(msg.windowEnd).toISOString();
if (msg.lastActionAt)        attrs.last_action_at = new Date(msg.lastActionAt).toISOString();
if (msg.lastAction)          attrs.last_action = msg.lastAction;
if (msg.lastActionReason)    attrs.last_action_reason = msg.lastActionReason;
if (msg.manualHoldUntil)     attrs.manual_hold_until = new Date(msg.manualHoldUntil).toISOString();

let stateStr = msg.state || msg.reason || 'Inconnu';
if (msg.degradedSonde) stateStr = 'Sonde HS · ' + stateStr;

msg.payload = {
    state: stateStr,
    attributes: attrs
};
return msg;
